newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil soybean export regs. 8.4 mln tns by July 15.
newsitem.headline: Brazil soybean export regs. 8.4 mln tns by July 15.

text.p: Brazil registered 8.39 million tonnes of soybeans for export by July 15, according to government figures released by the Brazilian Association of Vegetable Oils Industries (Abiove).
Export registrations for soymeal totalled 8.88 million tonnes and for soyoil they were 873,000 tonnes, according to figures from the state export department Secex.
Export registration figures are calculated as of February which is the beginning of the marketing year for Brazilian soybeans.
Abiove did not provide comparisons with last year as export registration figures for 1996 were only published on a monthly basis.
Soybean export registrations were 3.59 million tonnes by July 31 1996, while soymeal registrations stood at 9.15 million tonnes and soyoil at 1.09 million tonnes.
